JJK Season 3 won’t have a Part 2 ❌

It’s officially structured as
Season 3: Culling Game Part 1 ✅

Which means…
Season 3 ends with the Sendai Colony episode (Finale) 👀
Culling Game Part 2 will continue as Season 4

Release is expected around January 2027 🔥

No split cour this time a whole new season instead.

Are you ready for Season 4? 🗿
